purpose: Freeze value-independent geometry, dual-spectrometer pairing and visible-range stitching semantics before any selected Pandora209 sky-radiance array is opened.

geometryConvention.sunPosition: geometric solar center; no atmospheric-refraction correction for the MYSTIC Sun direction
geometryConvention.targetDirection: use the true per-spectrometer sky pointing recorded by the Pandora/Blick metadata, not merely a commanded/nominal shared pointing
pandoraPointingInputRequired: true pointing zenith angle for the exposure
true pointing azimuth angle for the exposure
metadata definition of azimuth reference and sign/convention
geometryConvention.relativeSolarAzimuth: fold the absolute target-minus-solar azimuth difference into [0,180] degrees after both are expressed clockwise from true north
geometryConvention.reason: s1 and s2 may have distinct true SkyFOV directions; collapsing them to one nominal pointing can silently introduce a directional twilight-radiance error

requiredSharedMetadata: routine/sequence/measurement identity sufficient to establish same intended sky observation
pairingAlgorithm.primaryRule: pair s1 and s2 only when PGN/Blick metadata explicitly establishes that the two records belong to the same dual-spectrometer observation or exposes an authoritative pairing key
pairingAlgorithm.fallbackWhenNoAuthoritativePairingKey: HOLD_OR_REJECT_UNRESOLVED; do not infer pairs from spectral values

preconditions: both s1 and s2 have independently documented absolute-radiance-valid wavelength intervals for the selected calibration validity period
the union of those intervals covers 380 through 780 nm without a gap
the two valid intervals overlap by a nonzero wavelength range
both records pass the metadata pairing rule
the wavelength grids and calibration/filter semantics are known before target values are opened
stitchAlgorithm.crossoverRule: let overlap=[max(s1ValidMin,s2ValidMin), min(s1ValidMax,s2ValidMax)]; choose crossover as its arithmetic midpoint using metadata only
stitchAlgorithm.spectralAssignment: use s1 calibrated radiance for admitted wavelengths below the crossover and s2 calibrated radiance for admitted wavelengths at or above the crossover
stitchAlgorithm.reason: a hard metadata-defined partition avoids outcome-driven relative scaling between spectrometers; any inter-spectrometer calibration discontinuity remains measurement/calibration uncertainty rather than being hidden by validation-data fitting

externalMetadataStillRequired: authoritative PGN/Blick meaning and units of the true per-exposure pointing fields
whether/how Pandora209 s1 and s2 records are authoritatively paired to the same optical observation
absolute-radiance-valid wavelength/filter interval for each spectrometer and calibration validity period
timing/exposure semantics and uncertainties for each spectrometer
pointing/FOV uncertainty and any documented s1/s2 co-alignment specification
